sentences.en: Since you will be traveling during the New Zealand winter, it might be easier to find cheaper airfares.

sentences.en: These dates are defined as "high season," which means cruises and airfares are at their most expensive because of the influx of travelers on the move.

sentences.en: Many websites and travel agencies offer discount airfares for students, whether they are traveling for school or vacation.
